The following events took place in approximately '''3400 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*Two Sith, the [[Dreamer]] and [[Monster-Slayer|The Monster-Slayer]], duel, ending in the death of both. Later, a [[Duel between The Dreamer and The Monster-Slayer|Sith legend]] arises from this duel.<ref name="The Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>

==Deaths==
*The [[Dreamer]]
*[[Monster-Slayer|The Monster-Slayer]]
